PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K (Asthma-Aware)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete a continuous 5K run in 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Walk-Run Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk-Run Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 8x1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk-Run Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          hip_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 8x1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk-Run + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 8x1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk-Run Build":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 6x2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk-Run Build":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          hip_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 6x2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          quad_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk-Run + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 6x2 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Walk-Run Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 10m

          ankle_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds

          running 5x3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Walk-Run Progression":

        cooldown:

      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk-Run + Strength":

          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 5x3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Deload Walk-Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m

      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m

        main straight_sets:
          running 4x3 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Extending Run Intervals" (4 weeks):

          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

    WEEK 6:

      DAY Saturday training 45m "Intervals + Strength":

    WEEK 7:

      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Two Long Runs":

      DAY Saturday training 45m "Continuous Attempt + Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 1x15 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 2x1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 2x8 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Deload Cross-Train":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          hip_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x20 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Deload Continuous":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 1x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Continuous Running to 5K" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Continuous Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
          leg_swings 2x10 rest 30 seconds
          ankle_circles 2x10 rest 30 seconds
        main straight_sets:
          running 1x18 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Easy Run + Strength":
        warmup:
